run_predictor_on_squad_dataset: run the DRQA reader predictor on a SQuAD-like JSON dataset and save predictions to an output directory
run_predictor_with_gpu: run the DRQA reader predictor on a dataset using a specified GPU device for CUDA acceleration
run_predictor_with_top_n_spans: run the DRQA reader predictor to store top N predicted answer spans with scores per question
run_predictor_in_official_eval_mode: run the DRQA reader predictor in official eval mode storing only the single top predicted span
run_predictor_with_custom_tokenizer: run the DRQA reader predictor with a custom tokenizer like corenlp and pretrained embedding file
